title: MEG-XL: Data-Efficient Brain-to-Text via Long-Context Pre-Training

live_model.evidence: Sec 1: "These samples are 5-300x longer than prior pre-trained models, and correspond to 191k tokens. This is similar to contexts in contemporary language models, e.g. GPT-4 Turbo (OpenAI, 2023)..." (context-length analogy only; also appears only in the bibliography).

data.source: Three MEG speech-decoding datasets (Sec. 4); not relevant since the live id is mention-only

notes: GPT-4 Turbo appears exactly once, as an analogy for context length (191k MEG tokens vs. contemporary LLM context windows), and once in the reference list.
